pr.title: refactor(server): route git config through one env helper and end option parsing before names
pr.body: ## What changed **One helper for git's command-line config** - New `gitConfigEnv` in `apps/server/src/vcs/VcsProcess.ts` appends an entry to git's `GIT_CONFIG_*` env config (argv stays identical on every platform; nothing is written to user config). It handles inherited counts and Windows' case-insensitive env names. - `windowsLongPathConfigEnv` now uses it. - Every git process T3 starts (`GitVcsDriverCore`, `VcsProcess`, `RepositoryIdentityResolver`) gets `safe.bareRepository=explicit`, so git only opens a bare repository named with `--git-dir` or `GIT_DIR`. Git before 2.38 ignores the setting. **Names are always names** - Remote, ref and path arguments come after `--` or `--end-of-options` in fetch, push, branch, remote, worktree, log, diff, show, merge-base and rev-list calls, in the GitHub provider, in glab `mr view/checkout`, and in ssh / ssh tunnel invocations. - Ref names starting with `-` (other than the lone `-` for the previous checkout) are refused before `checkout` and `worktree add`, since `--end-of-options` can't guard those on git < 2.44. - Forgejo's forced PR checkout requires the reported head to be a commit sha. **Pull request file expansion** - `diffFileContents` only reads files the pull request (or the selected commit) changes, checked against the same cached diff slices the reader was shown. `diffFileRevisions` gains `parseDiffFilePaths` for this. ## Behavior changes - A git folder that is bare-repository-shaped but not named explicitly is no longer opened. - Branch or remote names starting with `-` are refused or passed through as names, never as options. - Expanding a file the pull request doesn't touch returns `not-found`. - The `GIT_CONFIG_*` entries reach every process git starts, including the user's own hooks and credential helpers. A hook that runs git inside an undeclared bare repository now needs `--git-dir`. - `--end-of-options` needs git 2.24 or newer, which `rev-parse --end-of-options` already required. `safe.bareRepository` takes effect from git 2.38; older versions ignore it. ## Testing - Package tests pass: ssh, source-control-core/github/gitlab/forgejo. - Server tests: the touched suites pass locally and in CI. 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) ---
